events.verdict: Harris (LAC) grabs Rondo's (LAL) arm during the pick and it affects his FOM.
[Observable in enhanced video] James (LAL) hops consecutively on the same foot after he has gathered the ball.
Marjanovic (LAC) jumps A to B as he is drawn into the air when he makes body contact with McGee (LAL) during his initial dribble.
Harris (LAC) makes contact to the arm of McGee (LAL) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
[Observable in enhanced video] Chandler (LAL) steps into the lane before the shot release.
Rondo (LAL) reaches in and makes contact to Rondo's (LAL) arm after he's gather the ball on his driving shot attempt.
Chandler (LAL) makes incidental contact to the body of Marjanovic (LAC) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
Rondo (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Harris (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the marginal contact during the pick.
Harris (LAC) makes incidental "high-five" contact with James (LAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Stephenson (LAL) moves laterally into the path of Harris (LAC) during the drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Harris (LAC) makes incidental contact with James (LAL) as he moves alongside his body during his drive.
Chandler (LAL) and Marjanovic (LAC) both briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Chandler (LAL) slightly extends his arms against Beverley's (LAC) front during the screen, but he is able to move through contact.
Marjanovic (LAC) and Chandler (LAL) engage and separate during the rebound.

Bradley (LAC) grabs the rebound, does not take a dribble, and the Clippers immediately signal for a timeout that they are granted. When play resumes, the Clippers are initially given the ball to inbound along the baseline but officials conference and recognize that the ball should be advanced.
Marjanovic (LAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hart (LAL) and gives him room to avoid contact.
LLB shows Harris (LAC) cleanly blocks James (LAL) drive shot attempt.
Harris (LAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ingram (LAL) and absorbs the contact.

The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine if the ball was dislodged off of James (LAL) or Harris (LAC). Initially, the ruling was Lakers ball, and after review, the ruling was overturned to Clippers ball.
Rondo (LAL) makes incidental contact to the body of Williams (LAC) during his shooting motion that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Rondo (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Harris (LAC) and makes marginal contact, but he is able to move through it.
Harris (LAC) places a hand/arm to the front of James (LAL) during the drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Beverley (LAC) does not give McGee (LAL) a step to avoid the marginal contact during the pick, but it does not affect his ability to defend through the play.
Marjanovic (LAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ingram (LAL) and slightly extends his arm against Ingram's (LAL) front, but he is able to move through contact.
McGee (LAL) makes contact to the arm of Bradley (LAC) at the end of the drive, but the contact is marginal.
LLB shows Stephenson (LAL) extends his left arm and makes contact with Marjanovic's (LAC) head during his drive shot attempt and an offensive foul is warranted.

Referees went to replay to determine whether or not a hostile act occurred. Once review is initiated, the options for the on-court officials are: (i) increase the level of a foul already called (in this case, defensive foul), or (ii) if replay reveals a hostile act distinct from the contact called on the floor, provide a penalty for that act. In this case, upon review, the officials determined that there was no hostile act distinct from the contact called on the floor, even though that contact was incorrectly called.
Harris (LAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ingram (LAL) and gives him room to avoid contact.
After Stephenson (LAL) loses control of the ball in the back-court, Bradley (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball, causing a correctly whistled jump ball.
All Technical Fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Marjanovic (LAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Stephenson (LAL) and gives him room to avoid contact.
[Enhanced Video] Harris (LAC) takes more than two steps after he catches the pass.
Rondo (LAL) commits a take foul on Williams (LAC).
Marjanovic (LAC) slightly extends his arms against Ingram (LAL) during the screen, but he is able to move through contact.
